name: Kisaan Parivar Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Kisaan Parivar Industries Ltd is in the business of trading in agricultural products and related activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KPIL is in the business of organic farming and is one of the largest corporate farming-based companies. It develops and implements agricultural procedures and provides a one-stop destination for all agricultural land investors. The company has become a farming community which includes large scale and small-scale farmers

pros: Debtor days have improved from 211 to 57.5 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.58 Cr.
